title: From Solar Suitcases to Sparking Careers
summary: Hands-on STEM learning is helping Minnesota students see themselves in the clean energy transition
body_markdown:
Across Minnesota, students are opening small suitcases and discovering something much bigger inside: a hands-on introduction to clean energy.


Since 2019, Xcel Energy has supported We Care Solar in their mission to empower solar energy exploration, equip educators with the training and provide resources to bring STEM learning experiences to classrooms.


Designed for grades 7-12, We Care Solar’s multiweek Solar Solutionaries curriculum allows students to explore everything from the fundamentals of solar electricity to the engineering behind a working system. The key piece is the Solar Suitcase Learning Kit which features everything required to build a stand-alone 12-volt DC solar power system. The technology turns classrooms into solar learning labs.


“Light changes everything,” says Becky Goldberg, strategic lead of education for We Care Solar Education. “The Solar Solutionaries program helps teachers and students recognize that they have a role to play in the clean energy transition.”


The program encourages STEM development and real-world problem solving.


“We’re thrilled to be able to support this program,” says Sam Holsen, Social Investments Manager for Xcel Energy. ”We host teacher training workshops, bring educators to solar arrays, and provide teachers materials so they have what they need to be an expert in their classrooms.”


With support from Xcel Energy, We Care Solar Education has equipped more than 225 STEM teachers who have, in turn, inspired nearly 30,000 students.


“Xcel Energy doesn’t just bring clean energy to Minnesota; it’s building a pipeline of community knowledge and future clean energy talent, says Gigi Dekko Goldman, Co-Founder of We Care Solar Education. “As a Minnesota homeowner and Xcel Energy customer, I’m grateful for their care and commitment to our state.”


Holson believes that supporting educational opportunities like We Care Solar help to inspire the next generation of energy leaders.


“Our commitment to providing safe, reliable energy goes beyond our day-to-day work, he says. “It means investing in the people who will maintain and improve our energy system for generations to come. Through our work with We Care Solar, we’re putting that mission into action — connecting students with the tools and resources they need to build a stronger, more sustainable energy future.”
